answer: It fails closed: the V12 reference engine aborts the run and writes no run record at all. The engine writes a run record only after the model, scenario and result hashes are known, so a failed invariant leaves no partial or plausible-but-invalid result behind; a partial write (writing a record before an invariant check) is listed as a failure mode the design deliberately avoids. The run life cycle orders the steps as run replications, check invariants, aggregate metrics, convergence/sensitivity, hash result, then write run record, and the page states the engine 'fails closed on unknown identifiers and failed invariants.'
